# wsl_distribution (Data Source)

Looks up an existing WSL distribution registered on the host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wsl_distribution" "ubuntu" {
  name = "Ubuntu"
}

output "ubuntu_version" {
  value = data.wsl_distribution.ubuntu.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The distribution's registration name.

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) The distribution's current run state (e.g. "Running"/"Stopped") as observed from `wsl --list --verbose`. Informational only: on a non-English Windows host this text is localized.
- `version` (Number) WSL engine version the distribution runs under: 1 or 2.
